resources.string: Vehicle supports GB/T DC charging
Enable only if your actual variant supports DC charging. Used with battery reporting to Apple Maps; otherwise only the AC inlet is reported.
Use head-unit location
With location permission, continue sending head-unit GPS fixes after wireless handoff and while the camera window is shown. The iPhone must request location information.
Vehicle speed and gear for tunnel navigation
Use read-only BYD vehicle data when the iPhone requests it. Requires authorized network ADB and location permission. This also enables head-unit location reporting.
Electric battery and range for Apple Maps (experimental)
Report the battery and electric range using the upstream EV profile. For DM-i, fuel range is excluded. Requires authorized network ADB; iPhone support determines availability.
